d0_notes: Data source that records a sweep's effect: NONE directly. The sweep writes no activity-log row (confirmed in the audit; INFO line unreachable). 'No firing in occupied zones' is true in the LIGHTING denomination (any_room_occupied = 0 at 187/187 fire edges; code gate hvac.py:3036 _sweep_light_ok). Two edges show zone_presence_state 'occupied' with any_room_hvac_occupied 1 (HVAC tail), not lighting-occupied.

Per-zone opt-out overwritten: switch.py:4039 `zone.vacancy_sweep_enabled = self._is_on` runs for ALL zones from async_added_to_hass (switch.py:4067 _update_zones) and on every toggle, overwriting the per-zone config value read at hvac_zones.py:509/573.
